extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: y'' + py' + qy = 0

extracted_concepts.name: n阶常系数齐次线性微分方程
aliases: n-th order constant coefficient homogeneous linear differential equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 特征方程有 n 个根（含重根和复根），按规则写出通解

extracted_concepts.name: 特征方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: r² + pr + q = 0

extracted_concepts.name: 判别式 Δ
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 用于区分特征方程根的情况：Δ>0, Δ=0, Δ<0

extracted_concepts.name: 不等实根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ>0：y=C₁e^(r₁x)+C₂e^(r₂x)

extracted_concepts.name: 重根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ=0：y=(C₁+C₂x)e^(rx)

extracted_concepts.name: 共轭复根情形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ<0：y=e^(αx)(C₁cos βx+C₂sin βx)

extracted_concepts.name: 待定系数法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x)=Pₘ(x)e^(λx) 型，设 y*=x^k Qₘ(x)e^(λx)

extracted_concepts.name: 参数变易法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 设 y*=u₁(x)y₁+u₂(x)y₂，解方程组求 u₁', u₂'

extracted_concepts.name: 导数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 微分方程的核心是导数，方程中包含未知函数的导数

extracted_concepts.name: 原函数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 求解微分方程是从导数反推原函数
